items.docs:
Creates an OT connector. 

The response includes a token when you create the OT connector. The token is the only credential that is used for authentication when the OT connector connects to Tenable Vulnerability Management.

**Note:** You can generate the required linking key and retrieve the target site with the [Create linking key](ref:sensors-ot-linking-key-generate) endpoint.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of connector or sensor. This value is always `ot` for OT connectors.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The attribute used to sort the list of OT connectors.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: The criteria used to order the list of OT connectors. If this value is omitted, Tenable uses the default value `asc`.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of OT connectors to return. The valid range is [1-200].

params.name: exclusiveStartKey
params.description: The ID of the last OT connector included in the current result set. This parameter is used for paging through the results and it must be used in conjunction with the `exclusiveStartSortKey` parameter.

params.name: exclusiveStartSortKey
params.description: The value of the `sortBy` key for which to sort the returned list of OT connectors. It must be used in conjunction with the `exclusiveStartKey` parameter.

items.docs:
Generates a single-use linking key that is valid for two hours. Additionally, the target site for your account is retrieved (ex. `us-2b`). 

The linking key and target site are required when creating an OT connector with the [Create OT connector](ref:sensors-ot-create) endpoint.

Once linked, an OT connector can transmit assets and findings data from Tenable OT Security to Tenable Vulnerability Management. <div class="perms-callout">Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See [Roles](doc:role
